title: Request an Environmental Health Officer
description: Request an Environmental Health Officer to attend an event where food or drink is served to the public.

steps.title: Are you operating a temporary restaurant?

overrides.label: Are you operating a temporary restaurant (serving food) at this event?
overrides.hint: A temporary restaurant is any set-up serving food or drink to the public for 30 days or less. If you are serving food, you also need a temporary restaurant permit — we will collect that in this same form.

required.error: Select whether you are operating a temporary restaurant at this event

overrides.content: Because you are serving food, this request also includes your application for a temporary restaurant permit. We will ask about the food you serve and your food-safety arrangements.
You **do not need** to fill out a separate temporary restaurant permit form.

overrides.label: Mobile number
overrides.hint: We will use your mobile number to contact you. For example, (246) 249 1234.

overrides.label: Home telephone
overrides.hint: For example, (246) 433 1234.

overrides.label: Email address
overrides.hint: We will use this to contact you about your request. For example, you@example.com.

required.error: Enter the name of the event

overrides.label: Event address line 1
overrides.hint: Start typing, then choose your location from the list. We use it to send your request to the polyclinic that covers the area.

overrides.label: Start date
overrides.hint: The first day of the event. Apply at least 14 days before this date if you can. For example, 27 8 2026.

required.error: Enter the event start date

min.error: The event start date cannot be in the past

overrides.label: End date
overrides.hint: The last day of the event.

required.error: Enter the event end date

onOrAfter.error: The end date must be the same as or after the start date

overrides.content: Your event starts in fewer than 14 days. We ask for at least 14 days so an officer can be scheduled to inspect your set-up. You can still apply, but your application goes for manual review and may not be processed in time.

overrides.label: Start time
overrides.hint: The time the event starts each day. For example, 4:00pm.

required.error: Enter the time the event will start each day

overrides.label: End time
overrides.hint: The time the event finishes each day. If it runs past midnight, enter the time it ends — for example, 2:00am.

required.error: Enter the time the event will finish each day

overrides.summary: Why you do not choose officer times
overrides.content: The Environmental Health Department assigns officers based on your event's dates and times. This follows the Health Services (Assignment of Public Health Inspectors to Private Businesses) Regulations, 1986, which set officers' working days and hours (regulation 2 and the First Schedule) and the fees for attendance outside those hours (regulation 7 and the Second Schedule).
Give your best estimate of the size of your event. We know these numbers change — you will not be penalised if they do.

overrides.label: Expected number of patrons
overrides.hint: For example, 300.

required.error: Enter the expected number of patrons

overrides.label: Number of food stalls, including bars
overrides.hint: Count each bar as a stall. For example, 4.

required.error: Enter the number of food stalls including bars

overrides.summary: Why we ask, and what officers may check on the day
overrides.content:
The number tells us how many people an officer needs to check at your stall. Everyone handling food must wear a hairnet, wear a beard net if they have a beard, remove jewellery, and keep nails short, clean and free of varnish or false nails.

Each person needs their own valid medical certificate with them on the day. You only upload your own — we check the rest at the stall.

We know who works an event can change at short notice. Give the number you expect; you will not be penalised if the people change.

[Read the full hygiene requirements](https://alpha.gov.bb/business-trade/temporary-restaurants-what-you-need-to-know#personal-hygiene-for-food-handlers)

overrides.label: Number of male food handlers
overrides.hint: For example, 2.

required.error: Enter the number of male food handlers

overrides.label: Number of female food handlers
overrides.hint: For example, 3.

required.error: Enter the number of female food handlers

overrides.summary: Why we ask about water and sanitation
overrides.content:
Running water is mandatory. A stall without it can be closed on the day, and a permit cannot be issued in advance because an officer has to verify this in place.

**Contact your event organiser to check whether water will be available — but be prepared to bring your own.** Vendors have arrived at events expecting water to be provided and found none. Whoever supplies it, it is your stall that is closed without it.

[Read more about keeping food safe](https://alpha.gov.bb/business-trade/temporary-restaurants-what-you-need-to-know#keeping-food-safe)

overrides.label: Water source
overrides.hint: Where will safe water come from? For example, mains supply, a water tank, or bottled water.

required.error: Enter the water source for the event

overrides.label: Handwashing arrangements
overrides.hint: For example, a portable handwashing station with soap and paper towels.

required.error: Describe the handwashing arrangements

overrides.label: Waste disposal
overrides.hint: How will food waste and rubbish be stored and removed?

required.error: Describe how waste will be disposed of

steps.title: Request submitted
steps.markdownContent:
A copy of your request has been sent to the email address you gave and to the Environmental Health Department at **{polyclinic}**.

## What happens next

- The Environmental Health Department at **{polyclinic}** will review your request.
- The Environmental Health Department will conduct a risk assessment and may require more information including a site plan.
- The Environmental Health Department will also determine the number and cost of officers to be assigned.
- If there are overtime costs, they will send an invoice after the request is approved.
- All monies to be paid to the Consolidated Fund or to the Permanent Secretary of the Ministry of Health and Wellness **two days in advance** of the event.
- If you are also operating a temporary restaurant, this request includes your permit application.
- An officer checks your set-up, and if compliant, issues the permit at the event, not in advance. Permits are **non-transferable** - Permits are issued for a specific location and event, and may be valid for 30 days from the date of issue.
